epic.title: Epic: the door is the interface — finish the MCP migration (#567)
epic.intent_and_why: One interface for agents: the MCP door. The CLI becomes an operator and debug path only. The outcome that must not be violated is that this epic reduces complexity by removing a redundant path.

definition_of_done: A dispatched crew drives its own spine through the door end to end.
No agent-facing file teaches the CLI as a path for agents.
A guard refuses reintroduction of the CLI-fallback text.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: The merge gate is the full suite green on Linux, run in a clean detached worktree of the branch, never in a working copy. Engine and hook behaviour is validated in a fresh process with explicit paths; an in-session observation is not evidence.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Behaviour-level red-proofs against the shipped path rather than a fixture, plus a re-verify of main after each merge and not only of the branch before it.
good_enough.appetite: Two waves. Wave 1 unblocked; wave 2 subtracts and then closeout runs on the same contract.

hard_constraints: No lane files an issue during the run; triage candidates stage locally and are dispositioned at closeout.
No lane promotes an observation into docs/agents/*; that is a human's call.
No lane regenerates map/INDEX.md (#544); the Admiral regenerates once on the final merged main.
Design and candidate-generation work is never dispatched as a fork.
Windows CI's pre-existing ~122-failure path-casing baseline is not the yardstick (#575 deferred).
fixed_decisions: Launched wave-1 lane identities A, B, C, G remain stable and are merged and kept (#412).
Wave-2 lane identities are D1, D2, E, F, H as confirmed in Contract v2.
The workbench directory stays a template-only package; the four templates do not move.
#574's PR-opening question stays reserved for the human.

current_wave.objective: Unblock the doctrine sweep by making the door reach the caller's own spine, and land the three independent door-shaped subtractions alongside it.
exit_criteria: Lane A returns a converged design and an implementation for per-dispatch spine identity, or an evidenced honest null.
Lanes B, C and G return merged green PRs or evidenced honest nulls.
Each lane names what it deleted.
No issue was filed by any lane.

issues.title: Per-dispatch spine identity: the door reaches the caller's own spine (#559 anchor, + bind-own-spine, + #613 save() atomicity)
issues.desired_outcome: A role agent — dispatched subagent or top-tier orchestrator — reaches its own spine through the door, and the engine's save() stops being a lost-update race between concurrent writers.
issues.useful_now: It is the only thing blocking the doctrine sweep: you cannot delete a fallback that is currently the only path.
issues.appetite: One Commander at Opus tier, design-it-twice before converging.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A dispatched crew drives its own spine through the door end to end in a fresh process; or an evidenced finding that the property cannot be had without adding more mechanism than it removes.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose the mechanism. Convergence is human-only: return a comparison and a recommendation.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not merge before proving the edited engine drives the live spine: read-only current on the live spine, mutating verb against a copy.
Do not accept an in-session observation of hook or engine behavior as evidence.
local_unknowns: Whether the door can bind an existing spine without giving up the isolation the env-binding buys.

issues.title: ExternalBackend refuses a spineless success (#432)
issues.desired_outcome: A dispatched role that drove no spine at all can no longer return a clean success; the mtime-only verification path is gone.
issues.useful_now: The engine-drive rule is prose that nothing verifies, so a correct-looking result walks straight past it.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: A red-proof: a dispatch that drives no spine is refused, demonstrated against the shipped path rather than a fixture.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose where the check sits on the ExternalBackend path.
hard_constraints_no_gos: The check must be able to fail: assert against the behavior, never against text describing it.
local_unknowns: Whether the Agent-tool dispatch path has a chokepoint that can refuse at all, or only report.

issues.title: The rail and the HARD refusal read to a cold agent (#442), and the stop hook vs context-trip authority is settled (#595)
issues.desired_outcome: A cold agent shown only the rail and a HARD refusal can state what it is being asked to do and do it; and exactly one of the two competing advisory mechanisms has authority.
issues.useful_now: Agents read the RAIL banner as a possible prompt injection and discount the instruction it exists to deliver.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: Measured on a real cold agent, not judged by the author; and one of the two advisory mechanisms deleted or explicitly subordinated in shipped text.
issues.implementation_latitude: Rewrite the rail and refusal strings; choose which advisory wins.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not redesign the trip mechanic.
Adding a third advisory mechanism is out of bounds.
local_unknowns: Whether a cold-agent measurement can be run inside this wave's budget.

issues.title: One-verb mechanical closeout behind the door (#574), and archiving releases the lease (#552)
issues.desired_outcome: The agent says done and the engine does the rest; archiving a finished run releases its lease, so stale leases stop accumulating on disk.
issues.useful_now: 43 active leases on disk, 41 stale and 17 inside .agent-work/archive/, is live rot that grows every run.
issues.acceptance_or_falsification_evidence: The closeout sequence runs from one verb through the door, and an archived run holds no active lease; both proven in a fresh process.
issues.implementation_latitude: Choose how much of closeout the verb absorbs.
hard_constraints_no_gos: Do not accept an in-session observation of hook or engine behavior as evidence.
local_unknowns: Whether the 41 existing stale leases are cleaned by this change or need a separate sweep.
